name: Checkerz Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Checkerz Mania is a free checkers game. Get ready, get mad, get mad because this is a strategy game that you can enjoy from your computer or mobile device. This is an online game based on the classic board game of checkers. If you are looking for a simple game with classic rules, this is the online game for you. Depending on your expertise or even your mood, you have the option to select from easy, medium, hard, and expert. You also have the option of playing either the black or white piece. Even though you are playing against a computer, do not feel intimidated! The game will give you hints and strong suggestions as to what is the next best possible move. This is a great casual game that will train your mind without being overwhelming.
